work.title: Founder & Lead AI Engineer
work.description: ModelVault is an independent AI-engineering studio building production-grade, bespoke AI for businesses — predictive ML models, LLM agents, RAG systems and automation pipelines. Every solution is engineered end to end on a backend of seven FastAPI microservices hosted on ISO 27001–certified infrastructure in Italy. Quality over quantity: each model, a concrete advantage. It's where I'm turning applied AI into products companies can put into production — the start of my professional path.
work.description_it: ModelVault è uno studio indipendente di AI engineering che costruisce AI su misura, production-grade per aziende — modelli ML predittivi, agenti LLM, sistemi RAG e pipeline automation. Ogni soluzione è ingegnerizzata end-to-end su backend di sette microservizi FastAPI hosted su infrastruttura certificata ISO 27001 in Italia. Quality over quantity: ogni modello, un vantaggio concreto. È dove trasformo AI applicata in prodotti che le aziende mettono in produzione — l'inizio del mio percorso professionale.
responsibilities: Custom AI solutions: predictive models, LLM agents, RAG systems and automation pipelines
Engineered on seven FastAPI microservices — ISO 27001–certified infrastructure in Italy
End-to-end delivery: discovery, technical design, iterative build, deployment and monitoring
Client data stays in Italy and is never used to train third-party models
responsibilities_it: Soluzioni AI custom: modelli predittivi, agenti LLM, sistemi RAG e pipeline automation
Ingegnerizzato su sette microservizi FastAPI — infrastruttura certificata ISO 27001 in Italia
Delivery end-to-end: discovery, technical design, iterative build, deployment e monitoring

work.title: Internship & Master's Thesis
work.description: Curricular internship and Master's thesis at Fabbrica d'Armi Pietro Beretta — one of the world's oldest industrial companies — within its technological-innovation efforts. The work centers on applied Artificial Intelligence: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over technical knowledge bases and intelligent web-scraping pipelines, with a focus on AI-based innovation for industrial processes.
work.description_it: Tirocinio curriculare e tesi magistrale presso Fabbrica d'Armi Pietro Beretta — una delle aziende industriali più antiche al mondo — nell'ambito dei suoi sforzi di innovazione tecnologica. Il lavoro si concentra su Artificial Intelligence applicata: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) su knowledge base tecniche e pipeline intelligent web-scraping, con focus su innovazione AI-based per processi industriali.
responsibilities: Design and implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over technical and industrial knowledge bases
Development of intelligent web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines feeding the AI stack
Applied research on AI-based technological innovation for industrial workflows
Master's thesis: design, implementation and experimental evaluation of the proposed AI solution
responsibilities_it: Design e implementazione sistemi Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) su knowledge base tecniche e industriali
Sviluppo pipeline intelligent web-scraping ed estrazione dati che alimentano lo stack AI
Ricerca applicata su innovazione tecnologica AI-based per workflow industriali
Tesi magistrale: design, implementazione e valutazione sperimentale soluzione AI proposta
